single.rationale: Myers shows improving operational execution post-acquisition with operating margins recovering from 5.3% to 9.0% and strong free cash flow generation ($67M, 8.1% margin), but faces headwinds from declining revenues (-2.8% 3-year CAGR), elevated debt from the Signature acquisition ($346M vs. $294M equity), and economic uncertainties around tariffs and demand. The valuation appears reasonable at 12.5x P/FCF, but growth trajectory remains unclear.
